q0.q: Does the gift show up automatically?
q0.a: When your cart meets the promo rules, the gift line item appears before you pay — double-check the banner above checkout.

q1.q: Which sizes are included in the offer?
q1.a: XS through 3X stay in rotation; if a size sells out we will flag it on the PDP buttons.

q2.q: Can I mix colors in the bundle?
q2.a: Yes — pick any in-stock shades that qualify for the bundle SKU so you are not stuck with two identical colors.

q3.q: Will this work for fuller busts?
q3.a: The wide band spreads weight and the boning adds structure without wires; many DD+ shoppers use the fit quiz first.

q4.q: How do I keep the grip like new?
q4.a: Cold hand wash, reshape while damp, and air dry — heat from dryers can dull the silicone over time.
